name: webband-native
description: Capacitor shell for WebBand. The repo root stays build-free; everything npm touches lives in here.

scripts.www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -R ../index.html ../style.css ../sw.js ../manifest.webmanifest ../i18n.js ../lang-en.js ../lang-id.js ../vendor ../app.js ../battle.js ../battle-gl.js ../map-gl.js ../nobles.js ../quests.js ../bg_hdr.jpg ../kingdom_crests.jpg ../lord_portraits.jpg ../icon-192.png ../icon-512.png ../fonts ../music ../troops www/
scripts.sync: npm run www && npx cap sync
